description: Declared kind of every artifact leaf a page may format (Codex L2v3 N2). The number-provenance gate allows x100 / a '%' display only on ratio kinds, annualisation (x periods per year) only on a per-period return at the pair's own frequency (candidates manifest ppy), and +/-1 only on counts / leads. A leaf matching no rule has kind 'unknown': it may be shown as is (or negated / differenced with a leaf of the same kind) but never scaled. The first matching rule wins; patterns are searched in the source path (file#key/path).

rules.why: fractions of capital or of time (0.152 = 15.2%)
strategy / B&H return, volatility and drawdown fractions
share of null contests below the statistic
annualised returns (already annualised by the pipeline)
mean next-period return by quartile (per period)
probabilities reported as p-values (shown as is)
lead in the pair's period unit
